voice_description: Native Japanese female voice for an ethereal, cool and reserved young heroine in a fantasy anime. A clear, delicate youthful voice with an otherworldly stillness. Speak naturally and precisely: quietly call to an ancient will, gather resolve, then deliver the spell name with crisp decisive force. Her short reply is understated and reassuring. Not a mature narrator, not a cutesy delivery, and not a breathy whisper. Clean studio recording.
text:
月の裏に眠る、古き意志よ。
このやいばをしるべに、道を開け。
つきかげわたり！
任せて。
